🚤✈️ NEW UPDATE: MARINA & AIRPORT! ✈️🚤

🌊 NEW EXPANSION: THE MARINA

Boats sail down the new river and dock at YOUR marina to be washed!
11 new boats to wash, from the Speedboat to the Super Yacht… and a SECRET Duck Boat 🦆
11 new upgrades: Hull Jets, Spray Cranes, Foam Cannons, a Lighthouse, Yacht Club, Fish & Chips Shack, Fireworks Dock, Golden Anchor and more!

🛫 NEW EXPANSION: THE AIRPORT RUNWAY

Cross the bridge to your own airport!
Planes fly in over the city, land, and taxi up to be washed
11 new planes, from the Crop Duster to the Jumbo Jet… and a SECRET Duck Jet 🦆
11 new upgrades: a giant Wash Gantry, Wash Trucks, Runway Lights, Terminal, Radar Tower, Jet Hangar, Fire Truck Water Salute, Air Show and more!

🚁 4 NEW HELICOPTERS

Gyrocopter, Tandem Cargo Copter, Stealth Copter and the shiny Gold Copter!

⚙️ IMPROVEMENTS

The Upgrades menu now fits on one page, so no more scrolling!
New 🔊 Music ON/OFF button in the top bar

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
